## 📋 PR Title Format

**Please ensure your PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format:**

```
type(scope): description
```

**Examples:**
- `feat: Add new diff viewer`
- `fix(cli): Resolve link command issue`
- `docs: Update installation guide`
- `refactor(app): Simplify DotstashManager`
- `security: Patch path traversal vulnerability`

**Valid types:** `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `revert`, `security`, `deps`, `release`
